record.oneLiner: Hosted Postgres platform with an auto-generated REST API for database tables and a Management API for projects, authenticated with API keys, personal access tokens or OAuth2.
record.verdictReason: A free plan includes API access and project API keys are self-serve in the dashboard. The Data REST API is schema-driven, and the Management API is documented with personal access tokens; an official hosted MCP server also exists.

evidence.quote: You can find the API Keys in the Settings > API Keys section of the Dashboard.
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user.
Supabase auto-generates an API directly from your database schema
The hosted Supabase MCP server is available at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp.
